excavation_context.character_description: Adult male grad student, short red hair, freckled skin, wearing a khaki baseball cap, grey short-sleeve button-down shirt over a white tee shirt, khaki cargo pants, and brown hiking boots.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_2 is navigating a steep coastal bog stream cut. He points his rock hammer at a heavy, metallic nodule of rusty red-brown ironstone matrix half-buried in the clay. Protruding out from the hard mineral crust is a thick, water-worn predatory theropod claw. Bright, exposed daylight reflecting off his red hair and the metallic rock face. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
